item.title: Truck driver killed in single-vehicle crash on Pacific Motorway
item.description: The male driver was treated by NSW Ambulance paramedics but sadly died at the scene. Image: NSW Police A truck driver has died following a single-vehicle crash on the M1 Pacific Motorway on the NSW Central Coast earlier today. Emergency services were called to the Somersby section of the motorway at about 6.40am following reports a semi-trailer had crashed into a guard rail. item.title: Sydney-based transport company closes doors after 20 years
item.description: The Volvo fleet will be sold through auction house Pickles. Image: Gold Tiger Sydney-headquartered Gold Tiger Logistics Solutions is closing its doors after 20 years in business.
